candidate_evidence.quote: intradermal vaccination with autologous Wilms' tumor-1 (WT1) mRNA-loaded DCs weekly (-1 day, +2 days) for 3 weeks

role_evidence.quote: intradermal vaccination with autologous Wilms' tumor-1 (WT1) mRNA-loaded DCs weekly (-1 day, +2 days) for 3 weeks
